_README: EDIT THIS FILE FIRST. It is the only file you need to change to make this yours.
vault.name           -> the title at the top of your generated index.
vault.glossary_path  -> leave null unless you have a published glossary. Only the
optional concept layer uses it; the file index works without one.
categories           -> ORDERED. First match wins, so put narrow shelves first. Keywords
are matched against each filename (lowercased), so they should be
words that actually appear in your file names.
The three examples below are PLACEHOLDERS. Replace them with your own shelves. Anything
that matches nothing lands in 'Unidentified', which is not a failure — it is your to-do
list for retitling files whose names say nothing.
